profile.headline: Computer Engineer
profile.summary:
I am a computer engineer who is actively looking for a new position in the DC Metro area.  

It is important to me to find a career working for a company that has a great atmosphere and that appreciates a work life balance.  I also desire a career that I can continue to learn, grow and advance.

positions.title: Junior Software Engineer
positions.description:
-JavaScript, Typescript, Vue, and Python based coding
-Software testing using Jest and Cypress
-Table work with DynamoDB
-Utilized JIRA, Bitbucket & Confluence to help maximize workflow and communication between team members
-Front and back end software development for web application
-Laptop setup to assist with remote work during COVID pandemic

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description:
-Python based coding using Netmiko and Anxible modules
-Created solution to autonomously upload files to SharePoint
-Software development in automating workflow for multiple departments
-Code review and script maintenance

positions.title: Information Technology Help Desk Technician
positions.description:
-Configure and maintain CISCO based systems: wireless access points, routers, firewall, switches)
-Manage and setup email and applications: Microsoft Office 365 and Zimbra
-Setup and configured network, servers, and PC’s in a multi-million dollar building.  
-On-Call availability to assist with time sensitive network  and device emergencies.

positions.title: System Administration and Support I
positions.description:
-Utilized Active Directory for user account management.
-Monitored and resolved customer issues using TrackIt software
-Diagnosed malfunctioning hardware on workstations and replaced defective parts if necessary.
-Worked with security team to help monitor issues using CounterACT
